content: Be pirǝ azaa o maro o amare
Nangka Yeso ka mare obeya angmǝ me a pate, naka baya makeke ma Galili aaka lyǝ aa makeke ma Yahudiya, mamea mayo o tara obeno Urdung.
Na aromo a cak ne tare kai, naka womza ana makono aa saname.
Na maParisa ma yende ne deya a kai adorana ne kedeya kai, nane pirǝ na, “Azaa o baala makili Mosa, wa gwara obena oromo wa pere ondaye o wai aza ekeeya na?”
Naka kabare nee na, “Eta tukǝ soola obena, ondooka wa ye ne o bora, wa ye nea ondaleme kaa ondaye sang?”
Na akang bekaana, “Aza nyimi, oromo wa arnang kaa iini wai kaa ate a wai, a wa gwarnang ondaye wai. Neya leere kane itǝ lepung le yende.
A ale a izi neto itǝ apung a leere ne, leyendea yo za. Epaaka Ashili a gwaara tana oromo wa are ne.”
Nane beka kai na, “Nyimia waaza, eyaaka Mosa wa ote na a nya e wela omaro o amare, akang pere ondaaye?”
Na Yeso kabare naka bekaa nee na, “Azaa obena eye kaa anyong a katakau waya wa ote na Mosa kabare na e nya e wela opere amare, obora nyimia ta za ne.

Eyang bele oying kangza, pate ondooka wa arnang ka ondaye wai, azaa leyau lee taza ne, awa kang ale kawa ana ondaye yende kawa ote odo, wa ya epa e madinǝ naname. Ondooka wa ote ondaye omea a pere wai ba odo, wa ya leyau.”
Na atoma kai bekaa kai na, “Nyimia waaza a tera ondaleme kaa ondaye wai, odera o ana ondaye me wa kala.”
Naka bekaa nee na, “Komana wa era wata kabare ka oroka me ne, soona andaaka Ashili a kangkama ne.

Ana ondo ne zene ka a ngmeng ne agbele, ana ondo aromoa ne ote ne nane itǝ agbele. Ana ondo kangza ne tere o bena neto ana andaaye ne obena neya yeme togomo te zaa shili. Pate ondooka wayo ama o jeka orokaana, awa jeke.”
Yeso ka ayana a batebate
A were name, na ca Yeso ayana aa batebate adorna ka eke ne o ara, a kakang beye angmǝ kaa Ashili aa za one, na atoma kai ne zurki ba andaaka ne deya ka ayana me.
Na Yeso bekaa nee na, “Bayana ayana a batebate aa ne deya mi, tane nara nee ne, obena togomo te zaa shili te ebelo ene te.”
Na ka eese taara to kare o leba ba za one, aaka ale teweno te kai.
Ondaasau ooka waye ka ocǝ
Aya zaa nyimi na ondo paka ting Yeso nawa bekaa na, “Ondo baala, obelo edang ka maa eze ang cǝ ebeene o dera o maro?”
Na Yeso kabare wai naa, “Eyaaka oya pirǝ ong ba zaa epa edang? Ashili aya belle aye ka edang. Baaya yeme o cǝ ebeene odera o maro, o tare makili ma Ashili maana.”
Nawa beka Yeso na, “Makili ma Ashili maa yeme?” Na Yeso bekaa na, “Tana o wong ondo ne, tana o eze leyau, tana o eze bekǝri ne, tana o beye majǝkǝri ne.
Nya ate au ka iini o ogongha one. Kangza oo yeme ondooka wa cikǝ ating au, na ukpwei o.”
Na Ondasau me bekaa kai na, “Ma eza nyimi ba pat, eya tata mi kangza?”
Na Yeso bekaa wai na, “Ba ya yeme o cikǝ zora madinǝ, ale ka o lishi pate magogoro mau, o jeke emate me ka o nya ana o dera eyapa oyo itǝ ondo ocǝ aa zaa shili. O ama o de ka o tareng.”
Nangka ondasau me wa kone nyimi, nawa sokoo ale ka o caro lenyong, obena waya ka ocǝ maleu.
Na Yeso bekaa atoma kai na, “Eyang dongdong bele oying, wayo poba kaa ondo ocǝ wa lyǝ ba nyimi togomo ta zaa shili.
Eyang kang bele oying. Mara orongkoome wa lyǝ a le'o beberkena ka obena ondo ocǝ wa lyǝ ba nyimi togomo to Ashili.”
Nangka atoma Yeso ne kone nyimi, na epame tera ne tukpwei maleo, nane bekaana, “Nyimia waaza, mana wa era wa cǝ o boza?
Na Yeso laka ne aaka bekaa na, “Enna ara aromo e pobe oya, ara Ashili ekeeya e era eye.”
Na Biturusu kabare nawa bekaana, “Ro naana, te arnang ka ekeeya azaa o tare o. Eya teyo cǝ?

Na Yeso bekaa nee na, “Eyang dongdong bele oying, a tomore to deya, awereaka Kena ka Oromo yo cikǝ aa ledǝndǝ lee gong le togomo to kai, ying ka e tareng, eyo cikǝ ara to cikǝ be tuuru ka leere, e core angmǝ ba zaa tokwilǝ be tuuru ka leere a maIsrela.
Kangza pate ondooka wa baya tokwilǝ, kaa arone andaleme, na arone andaaye, kaa ate, kaa iini, na ayana, na turu, ba za leze leng, wayo cǝ o ripitini liwinu, a wa kang cǝ ebene odera omaro.
Bangka nyimi, aromo a cak ana o bora neyo itǝ ana o maare, aa ana o maare neyo itǝ ana o bora.”
